tasks.objective: Bounded agentic tool loop on typed Action executor
acceptanceCriteria: A model can propose multiple typed Actions in one turn; each passes executeAction validation.
ActionResult is returned to the model enabling follow-up proposals; iteration is bounded (max depth).
Write actions require confirmation; every step is logged through R2 observability.
Malformed/invalid proposals are rejected, never executed; rate limits still apply.

tasks.objective: User-grounded RAG retrieval into estimator context
acceptanceCriteria: estimateNutrition retrieves the user's prior nutrition-log items and injects top-N as context before the LLM call.
A user who logged a food once gets grounded estimation on a later call (R3 golden eval case).
Retrieval failure degrades gracefully (falls back to the default prompt, no crash).
All estimation remains schema-validated (Zod) and tagged estimated.
lib/llm-observability.ts wraps the LLM call and records latencyMs, promptTokens, completionTokens, estimatedCost, scenario, fallback, errorCode per call.
ai_call_logs table added via Supabase migration with RLS scoping to the caller's user.
/api/ai/health exposes call volume, avg latency, fallback rate, cost/week (read-only).
A failing LLM call is recorded with fallback=true and never breaks the route.

tasks.objective: LLM evals harness (golden sets): classifier + estimator
acceptanceCriteria: eval/golden-classifier.json and eval/golden-estimator.json exist with labeled fixtures.
eval/run-evals.ts runs both LLM steps and prints per-case pass/fail plus aggregate accuracy/regression.
Default Vitest suite mocks the LLM (deterministic, CI-safe); a scheduled/opt-in job runs real-model evals.
A prompt edit cannot regress model accuracy without a failing golden case.

acceptanceCriteria: A tool registry exposes typed, validated actions to workers.
Tool invocation is governed by the GOS-45 permission model / path allowlist (fails closed).
Invalid or unallowed tool calls are rejected and never executed.

tasks.objective: Controlled-learning retrieval into agent context â adopt R3 pattern
acceptanceCriteria: At run start, agent context is augmented by retrieval of prior approved lessons / proven graphs.
memory/ dirs are populated with at least one retrievable, approved lesson.
Retrieval failure degrades gracefully (run proceeds without injected context).

tasks.objective: Eval-gated review/promotion (controlled learning) â adopt R1 pattern
acceptanceCriteria: Review decision surfaces an eval score (judge + golden cases where applicable) alongside validation.
Worker content below the eval-score threshold cannot be promoted (fail-closed).
Controlled-learning dirs (memory/, improvements/) gain at least one approved, documented lesson.

The recorded Stage 6 observability invariant is satisfied; its WAVE-A note updates from scheduled to implemented.
